sections.overview: A Brazilian pimelodid catfish recorded from the Iguaçu River.
sections.identification: It is a described member of Steindachneridion; the genus revision diagnoses the group using shared skeletal and fin characters.
sections.ecology: It is a congener of S. doceanum, recorded from the Doce basin.
